relations.statement: Under an injective edge embedding compatible with the vertex map, Phi of the restricted window is at most Phi of the enlarged window, so growth cannot lower Phi1.
relations.hypotheses: Injective epsilon, compatible vertex map iota, IsPhi holds on both windows.

relations.statement: d1 descends to kappa on Q1 iff d1 composed with d0 is zero, so cohomology language fails when d1 d0 is nonzero.

lemmas.statement: Growth of a window cannot lower Phi1 (Chapter 21 countermodel item), restating the existing Lean theorem.

near_misses.claim: Quotient well-definedness holds even if a representative change alters the value.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Representative change must leave the value unchanged; otherwise the quotient map is not well defined.

near_misses.claim: Cohomology language is valid when d1 d0 is nonzero.
